# Windows365ConnectionLogs

Windows365 Connection Activity Logs. Contains connection lifecycle data for Cloud PC sessions, correlated with other datasets through ActivityId.

## Table attributes

|Attribute|Value|
|---|---|
|**Resource types**|microsoft.intune/operations|
|**Categories**|Azure Monitor|
|**Solutions**| LogManagement|
|**Basic** table support|Yes|
|**Auxiliary / Lake** table support|Yes|
|**DCR workspace transformation** support |No|
|**Ingestion API** support|No|
|**Sample Queries**|-|
